Ginger the giraffe takes a voyage to a magic show. On the stage, the magician puts a gem in a cage. But a bird flies in the cage and takes the gem! We all look for the gem until our energy is gone. With her giant neck, Ginger spots the gem in a nest. Ginger gently lifts the gem, and the magician says, “Nice job!” La jirafa Ginger hace un viaje a un espectáculo de magia.
